description: NaCl₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven Cl atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.81-3.28 Å. There are three inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted L-shaped geometry to one Na and one Cl atom. The Cl-Cl bond length is 2.12 Å. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na and one Cl atom. The Cl-Cl bond length is 2.53 Å. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Cl atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ClNa₂Cl₂ tetrahedra.
